Title: Search Tools Roadmap
Content: Search is central to MemorySmith's usefulness. Keyword search remains the reliable baseline; semantic search adds local concept scoring and explanations; hybrid search now combines Lucene.NET lexical analysis with the semantic signal using reciprocal rank fusion (RRF). The near-term semantic baseline can use local token scoring and project tags, but the durable version should use embeddings or another vector-capable index with clear fallback behavior while preserving the hybrid API shape.
